title: A new site
description: Why I rebuilt my personal site on Astro, and what it will cover.
text: The business card site from 2017 has been replaced. It is now Astro with a blog based on the AstroPaper design. It builds to static files and is published on GitHub Pages. Posts are split into topics tags : tech — architecture, backend, tooling; personal — life, thoughts and everything else. The CV is here /cv/ .
